start:
@startuml
actor user
participant app
user -> app: login
alt [valid]
  app --> user: token
@enduml

after.text:
@startuml
actor user
participant app
user -> app: login
alt [valid]
  app --> user: token
app -> user : message()
@enduml

uml-pg-tool-status.text: Added Synchronous message from "app" to "user". Tool stays active - drag another message or press Esc.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

uml-pg-diagnostics.text: Draft diagnosticsYour draft is retained. These checks cover common notation problems, not every UML constraint.Line 5: alt is missing its closing end.

after.properties:
- region "Relation — app → user":
  - heading "Relation — app → user" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Type
  - combobox "Type":
    - option "Synchronous" [selected]
    - option "Asynchronous"
    - option "Return"
    - option "Create"
    - option "Lost"
    - option "Found"
  - text: Source endpoint
  - combobox "Source endpoint":
    - option "user"
    - option "app" [selected]
  - text: Target endpoint
  - combobox "Target endpoint":
    - option "user" [selected]
    - option "app"
  - text: Label
  - textbox "Label": message()
  - button "Invert direction"
  - group "Message order":
    - text: Message order
    - button "Move earlier"
    - button "Move later"
  - paragraph: Drag a message line up or down to reorder it, or press Delete to remove it.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
